rachel: FYI hit a weird onboarding regression in sample-sdk v0.11.0. When a token refresh triggers a retry during a streaming json-mode toolcall, the replayed buffer arrives as an escaped string downstream. customer test failed during integration.
tom: ouch. short repro?
rachel: 1) start tool stream with json-mode and preserveStrings=false 2) mid-stream auth refresh causes retry 3) retry wrapper replays buffered data which was kept as rawText and does JSON.stringify on it -> consumer sees a quoted JSON string instead of an object
priya: can we stop relying on heuristics (safe-parse) in the retry path? i'd rather expose explicit format metadata on the buffer. e.g. streamer attaches format: 'json' | 'text' to each buffered chunk so replay can choose the right serialization.
tom: agreed. propose a tiny buffered contract: StreamBuffer { getFormat(): 'json'|'text'; getAsObject(): object | null; getAsText(): string } So retry can call getAsObject when format==='json' and avoid double-stringify.
priya: example API sketch:
```js
// streamer internal
buffer.push({ format: 'json', chunks: [...], getAsObject() { return reconstructedObject }, getAsText() { return rawText } })
// retry logic
if (buffer.getFormat() === 'json') { body = buffer.getAsObject() } else { body = buffer.getAsText() }
fetch(url, { body: JSON.stringify(body), ... })
```
nate: +1. this also makes node/python parity explicit. right now node exposes bufferAsObject() and py exposes to_text(), inconsistent. please add a small interface doc and tests.
priya: test plan: unit tests for StreamBuffer methods, integration test that mocks auth refresh mid-stream and asserts consumer gets object when format='json', runs in both runtimes in CI matrix.
tom: created ticket #2810: "sdk: streaming buffer must expose explicit format metadata to avoid double-encode on retry" assigned to @tom
bench-bot: linked PR 1044 (temporary guard in sample-kit) and issue #2810.
rachel: temporary PR with safe-parse-if-string merged to unblock the customer: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sample-kit/pull/1044. will revert after the contract lands. thanks everyone for quick triage :thumbsup:
